name: wwdc-mcp
description: Current Apple platform research for coding agents: WWDC sessions, Apple documentation, Human Interface Guidelines, Swift Evolution, App Review guidance, API availability, deprecations, and cross-references.

interface.longDescription: Search and cross-reference WWDC sessions, Apple Developer Documentation, Human Interface Guidelines, Swift Evolution, App Review guidance, release notes, API availability and deprecations. WWDC MCP is read-only and designed to ground iOS, macOS, visionOS, watchOS, tvOS, and Swift engineering work in current first-party sources.
defaultPrompt: Find the current Apple guidance for this API and cite the sources.
Audit this Swift code against current WWDC and Apple documentation.
What changed in this Apple framework across recent WWDC releases?

positive.prompt: Find current Apple guidance for NavigationSplitView and cite the strongest sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current first-party Apple guidance with source links and avoid unsupported claims.

positive.prompt: When was NavigationSplitView introduced and which WWDC sessions explain it?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify introduction history and relevant WWDC sessions with links.

positive.prompt: What do the current App Review Guidelines say about in-app purchase?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the relevant current guideline sections and link to Apple.

positive.prompt: Check the availability and deprecation status of UIWebView and what replaced it.
positive.expected_behavior: Report documented availability and deprecation plus the supported replacement without inventing dates.

positive.prompt: Summarize how Apple guidance on Swift concurrency changed across recent WWDC sessions.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare relevant sessions across years and cite the session sources.

negative.prompt: Submit my app to App Store Connect and release it.
Rewrite my Xcode project files directly.
Delete all indexed Apple documentation from the server.

review.commerce_description: WWDC MCP provides read-only developer research and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public remote release for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, and the official MCP Registry.
